about: Project page and coordinator cards: iOS/web/Android parity (board docs/mocks/ios-project-page-and-coordinator-cards/,
owner decision D1 A). One settled APPROVE decision with one rewording and one addition, as the owner's read of
pending criteria decisions publishes it (`settled[]`), and what the receipt's fold "What this approved · …" says
about it. Web reads it in src/web/src/components/CriteriaDecisionCard.receiptFixture.test.tsx, OrbitKit in
`snapshot`: a decision recorded since 0279, which carries the diff it was answered against (web `SettledDiff`).
`proposal`: an older one whose diff predates the snapshot, drawn from the proposal's own side (web `SettledProposal`).
`expected.summary` is the fold's closed line. `expected.rows` are the moved criteria in order: `ordinal` (null for a
dropped one, which has no place), `text` (every run of the row's words joined, struck-through runs included) and
`badge`. `expected.unchanged` is the fold over the untouched criteria (snapshot only): its line and its rows.
`expected.legend` is the inline-diff legend, null where nothing is struck through. `expected.note` is the quiet
line under the rows, null where there is none.
